source: TelecomGPT RCA Assistant — inspired by 5G network troubleshooting workflows (call drop, throughput, latency, RACH, HO)

workflows.title: Call drop / connection release
likely_causes: Low SINR / RSRP degradation at cell edge
checks: Plot drop events vs SS-RSRP/SS-SINR on drive route
Review RRC re-establishment success rate and RLF counters
Check beam failure ratio and beam management KPIs
Verify neighbor relations and HO parameters
Inspect core AMF release cause if RAN RF looks healthy
actions: Add or tune neighbor relation for mobility path
Investigate interference source on affected PCI
validation_checklist: Drop rate returns below operator threshold for 24h
No RLF cluster on same geo segment after fix

rules.probable_cause: RSRP acceptable but SINR poor — likely interference or beam issue
Coverage-limited drops — RF below cell-edge threshold
actions: Consider small cell or tilt optimization

rules.probable_cause: Sudden SINR degradation driving RLF / context release

workflows.title: Low DL/UL throughput
checks: Plot throughput vs CQI, BLER, RI/MCS distribution
Compare SS-SINR and SS-RSRQ at low-tput samples
Verify CA, MIMO layers, and active BWP
Check transport/UPF if RF KPIs are healthy
actions: Validate MIMO beam weights and rank indicator
Check overshooting neighbor causing high BLER
validation_checklist: Mean DL throughput meets cluster target
CQI and BLER within fair/good bands
RI distribution shows expected MIMO layers

rules.probable_cause: Throughput limited by poor radio quality — low CQI with high DL BLER
Low CQI capping MCS — scheduler cannot assign high TB size
High BLER causing HARQ retx and throughput collapse
MIMO stuck at rank-1 — layer adaptation not scaling
Good RSRP but poor SINR — interference limiting throughput

workflows.title: High latency / QoS delay
likely_causes: RAN scheduling delay (secondary if core healthy)
checks: Compare latency vs time-of-day and UPF load
Verify 5QI / QoS flow mapping for affected service
Check transport utilization N3/N6
Rule out RAN if RF KPIs healthy — focus core path
actions: Correct QoS / 5QI mapping for GBR service
Investigate transport QoS on congested link

workflows.title: RACH / PRACH failure
likely_causes: Preamble not detected — RF too weak
checks: Verify prach-ConfigurationIndex and root sequence in SIB1
Check Msg1/Msg3 success in UE log
Compare PRACH SINR vs access threshold
Review TA values and collision on PRACH occasions
actions: Align PRACH config with band / SCS plan
Resolve PCI conflict on co-channel neighbor
Adjust cell radius / TA parameters if edge UEs fail
validation_checklist: RACH success rate above operator threshold
PRACH SINR fair or good on test route

rules.probable_cause: RACH failures likely RF-limited — weak PRACH detection

workflows.title: Handover / mobility failure
likely_causes: Target cell not prepared in time
Coverage gap between source and target
checks: Compare source/target RSRP at HO decision
Verify neighbor list includes target PCI
Check HO preparation timer and Xn connectivity
Review RLF events correlated with HO attempts
actions: Add missing Xn neighbor for target PCI
Close coverage gap on HO corridor
validation_checklist: HO success rate restored to SLA
No prep-fail spike on same neighbor pair

rules.probable_cause: HO failures may be RF-driven — target cell too weak at decision point
actions: Adjust thresholds or add filler cell
